text.tspan: One call returns availability AND the authoritative prices,
so the price persisted below is the one that was validated.
If this fails, do NOTHING. No compensating call: a compensation
issued by a process that may have just died is not a recovery
mechanism. The reservation expires on its own.
the reservation row is a single-use token.
RECOVERY — the property that makes this correct.
Every repair runs inside catalog, as a local transaction, on the
database that owns the stock. Nothing has to survive a crash.
An order stuck at CREATED whose reservation expired
is reconciled to CANCELLED. No stock was ever lost.
